newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit Conrowa's IPO 112 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit Conrowa's IPO 112 times subscribed.

text.p: Leading Spirit Conrowa Electric Co Ltd (LSC), a unit of Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd, said on Friday its initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong was subscribed by 112.57 times.
The company said it received applications for a total of 30.98 billion shares compared with 275.18 million shares available for public subscription.
It also said a preferential shares offer to the existing shareholders of Leading Spirit (Holdings) had been oversubscribed and the shares reserved for employees were fully allotted.
Trading in LSC shares is due to commence on June 26.
The electrical home appliances maker and distributor offered a total 393.12 million shares at HK$1.00 each in IPO.

Of the total, 20 percent of the issue was offered to the existing shareholders of its parent in the proportion of one LSC share for every 50 Leading Spirit shares held, and one free LSC warrant for every 30 Leading Spirit shares held.
LSC said up to 131.04 million warrants was offered to the shareholders of its parent.
Another 10 percent of the issue was earmarked for employees with the balance for public subscription.
LSC said its parent would hold 70 percent of the company following the listing.
